title: The Rock Shop
content: I think I mentioned in a previous post that I've been having this dream since I was a kid -- at the time, the scenes mostly stuck inside the actual mall. One of the earliest, recurring stores I remember was this totally glass storefront, which was completely covered in strobe lights, swirling patterns, colorful strings of Christmas bulbs and neon loops. For maybe a decade it was like an anchor store of the dream -- sometimes when I saw it, I became lucid. In a way, I guess it was almost like a totem -- except in reverse? A lot of the Mall is basically a pastiche of about a half-a-dozen famous and not so famous shopping malls in the greater Chicagoland area. Recently, I moved back to the town I lived in when I was youngest -- from birth to about four. It's also home to one of the malls that most resembles the one in my dream. I was there almost constantly as a little kid -- as well as shuttled around the rest of the town on errands, etc. All of this is to say that I've spent most of my adult life -- having this dream at least weekly -- pretty convinced that the dream is an intricate construction of my subconscious aided by an overactive imagination and a crippling case of ADHD.
